pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal and sub-ovoid dark regions with smooth edge gradients due to image resolution limits; patches are clustered with varying spatial areas across the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous topological web of light pelage; junctions are clearly defined as multi-directional nodes; channel width is narrow and maintains consistent continuity between patch boundaries.
